description: This file contains shell script functions and configurations for PPP (Point-to-Point Protocol) setup, including support for various PPP protocols such as pppd, pppoe, pppoa, pptp, and related teardown and initialization routines.

methods.name: ppp_select_ipaddr
methods.description: Selects the appropriate IP address from a list of subnets based on mask size.

methods.name: ppp_exitcode_tostring
methods.description: Converts PPP exit codes to human-readable string descriptions.

methods.name: ppp_generic_setup
methods.description: Sets up PPP connection with provided configuration and parameters.

methods.name: ppp_generic_teardown
methods.description: Tears down PPP connection and handles error notifications.
